lines.text: Jesus left Judea for Galilee, passed through Samaria, and sat weary by Jacob's well in Sychar.
Jesus asked a Samaritan woman for a drink, and she was surprised because Jews do not associate with Samaritans.
Jesus told the woman to call her husband, said she had had four husbands, and she called Him a prophet.
Jesus told the woman He was the Messiah, and she left her water jar and told the people in the town.
Many Samaritans believed because of the woman's testimony, and Jesus stayed with them seven days.
